cells.gaps: No regulation or decree applying the law, and no rule made under it that others must check identity against the system, dated in the last three years, is held.
cells.note: Rebuild 2026-10-31: The Civil Status Code as amended in February 2025 provides for the national biometric population register (MRT-002), so it counts as the identity law; no rule made under it is held. Stage 4 holds.
